answer: A single rigger spends 2 years and 120 harbour examinations to earn it; a farm of a thousand pays a thousand times. An honest agent arrives holding Majestic rigger registration with riggers attestation: a registration riggers renew after harbour audits. The canyon is the proof, the glacier is what a faker must pay for, and the karst is the record the next epoch checks. The record is what makes it stick.
